meta.description: 从 checklist.xlsx 的两个 sheet 抽取的字段比对规则，机器可读。logic 中统一使用完整文件代码（如 DRAWDOWN_INSTRUCTION），不使用缩写。一个 DRAWDOWN_INSTRUCTION 可对应多个 PAYMENT_INSTRUCTION 实例；单个 PAYMENT_INSTRUCTION 的 amount 为单笔金额，多笔汇总在 logic 中用 sum(all PAYMENT_INSTRUCTION.amount) 表示。

sheets.Sheet1: 提款指令核心比对（授信使用申请书 vs 授信函/贷款合同 vs 支付指令）
sheets.支持性文件检查: 贸易背景支持性文件交叉比对

DRAWDOWN_INSTRUCTION.zh: 授信使用申请书（提款指令）

PAYMENT_INSTRUCTION.zh: 支付指令（境外汇款申请书）

rules.logic: if DRAWDOWN_INSTRUCTION.date is not null: assert DRAWDOWN_INSTRUCTION.date >= DRAWDOWN_INSTRUCTION.referenced_facility_letter_date and DRAWDOWN_INSTRUCTION.date >= DRAWDOWN_INSTRUCTION.drawdown_date; else: skip
rules.note: FOL侧为NA，仅比较提款指令自身三个日期：date 不早于 referenced_facility_letter_date（引用的授信函订立日期），也不早于 drawdown_date（拟授信使用日）；为空则忽略

rules.logic: if FACILITY_LETTER.lender_branch is specific: assert DRAWDOWN_INSTRUCTION.branch == FACILITY_LETTER.lender_branch; elif FACILITY_LETTER.lender_branch == '通过任一或多个分支行行事': warn('请用户检查分支行')
rules.note: 必填；FOL指定具体分支行时需一致；FOL为'任一/多个分支行'时提示用户检查

rules.logic: assert DRAWDOWN_INSTRUCTION.referenced_facility_letter_date in FACILITY_LETTER.date (original or latest)
rules.note: 提款指令中引用的授信函日期应等于FOL最初或最新的日期

rules.logic: assert not is_holiday(DRAWDOWN_INSTRUCTION.drawdown_date, country='CN') and not is_holiday(DRAWDOWN_INSTRUCTION.drawdown_date, currency=DRAWDOWN_INSTRUCTION.currency) and DRAWDOWN_INSTRUCTION.drawdown_date >= today
rules.note: 必填；不应为中国及对应币种节假日；不早于当前日期

rules.logic: if DRAWDOWN_INSTRUCTION.tranche is not null: assert DRAWDOWN_INSTRUCTION.tranche matches one of FACILITY_LETTER.tranches (ignore zh/en diff)
rules.note: 可空/NA；有值时应在FOL对应段落中存在该授信段，内容一致（忽略中英文差异）

rules.logic: assert DRAWDOWN_INSTRUCTION.facility in FACILITY_LETTER.facilities (same wording)
rules.note: 必填；指令所填内容应在FOL对应段落中有相同表述

rules.logic: if FACILITY_LETTER.utilization_currency == 'any currency agreed by lender': skip; else: assert DRAWDOWN_INSTRUCTION.currency in FACILITY_LETTER.allowed_currencies
rules.note: 必填；币种应在FOL授信条款范围内；若FOL为'贷款人同意的任何币种'则忽略

rules.logic: assert DRAWDOWN_INSTRUCTION.amount <= FACILITY_LETTER.facility_amount
rules.note: 必填；提款金额应 <= FOL对应授信金额

rules.logic: if DRAWDOWN_INSTRUCTION.interest_period is not null: if FACILITY_LETTER.interest_period is 'agreed by lender' pattern: skip; elif FACILITY_LETTER.interest_period is list: assert DRAWDOWN_INSTRUCTION.interest_period in FACILITY_LETTER.interest_period_list; else: assert DRAWDOWN_INSTRUCTION.interest_period == FACILITY_LETTER.interest_period
rules.note: 可空/NA；有值需与FOL一致；FOL多值满足其一即可；FOL为'贷款人同意的'则忽略

rules.logic: if FACILITY_LETTER.interest_rate is 'agreed by lender' pattern: skip; else: assert DRAWDOWN_INSTRUCTION.interest_rate == FACILITY_LETTER.interest_rate (combined from options)
rules.note: 必填；利率由选项组合而成，应与FOL对应利率一致；FOL为'贷款人与借款人约定'则忽略

rules.logic: assert not is_holiday(DRAWDOWN_INSTRUCTION.maturity_date, country='CN') and not is_holiday(DRAWDOWN_INSTRUCTION.maturity_date, currency=DRAWDOWN_INSTRUCTION.currency); term = DRAWDOWN_INSTRUCTION.maturity_date - DRAWDOWN_INSTRUCTION.drawdown_date; if FACILITY_LETTER has special_term: assert term <= FACILITY_LETTER.special_term; if FACILITY_LETTER has term_clause: assert term <= FACILITY_LETTER.term_clause (may need user-input base date); check against FACILITY_LETTER.repayment_schedule using cumulative_drawdown (user-input historical total); ai_generate_repayment_schedule()
rules.note: 必填；到期日不应为节假日；期限不超FOL要求；可能需用户输入基准日期和历史提款总额；AI生成还款计划

rules.logic: assert DRAWDOWN_INSTRUCTION.purpose within FACILITY_LETTER.purpose_scope and DRAWDOWN_INSTRUCTION.purpose not in FORBIDDEN_PURPOSES
forbidden_purposes: 固定资产投资(固定资产贷款除外)
房地产市场(房地产开发贷除外)
支付奖金/管理人员绩效工资
新增地方政府隐性债务
国家禁止生产经营的领域
rules.note: 必填(勾选部分可不填)；用途需在FOL范围内且不属于禁止用途清单

rules.logic: assert matches_regex(DRAWDOWN_INSTRUCTION.payment_account, r'^(\d{3}-\d{6}-\d{3}|\d{12})$')
rules.note: 必填；我行12位账号；格式 xxx-xxxxxx-xxx 或 xxxxxxxxxxxx

rules.logic: if DRAWDOWN_INSTRUCTION.amount > FACILITY_LETTER.disbursement_threshold: assert DRAWDOWN_INSTRUCTION.disbursement_method == '银行受托支付'
rules.note: 必填；提款金额大于FOL阈值时应勾选'银行受托支付'

rules.logic: assert DRAWDOWN_INSTRUCTION.commitment_text == STANDARD_COMMITMENT_TEXT
rules.note: 承诺内容应与标准内容一致

rules.logic: no_constraint
rules.note: 提款指令与支付指令币种可以不相等

rules.logic: if DRAWDOWN_INSTRUCTION.currency == PAYMENT_INSTRUCTION.currency: assert sum(all PAYMENT_INSTRUCTION.amount) >= DRAWDOWN_INSTRUCTION.amount; else: assert fx_convert(sum(all PAYMENT_INSTRUCTION.amount), PAYMENT_INSTRUCTION.currency, DRAWDOWN_INSTRUCTION.currency) >= DRAWDOWN_INSTRUCTION.amount
rules.note: 一个提款指令可对应多笔支付指令；币种相等时支付指令各实例 amount 加总 >= 提款金额；不等时按提款币种折算后加总 >= 提款金额

rules.logic: assert PAYMENT_INSTRUCTION.amount_in_words == to_words(PAYMENT_INSTRUCTION.amount)
rules.note: 大写金额应与汇款金额一致

rules.logic: assert DRAWDOWN_INSTRUCTION.payment_account == PAYMENT_INSTRUCTION.payee_account
rules.note: 放款指示账号与支付指令账号一致

rules.logic: assert FACILITY_LETTER.borrower == PAYMENT_INSTRUCTION.remitter_name
rules.note: FOL借款人名称与支付指令汇款人名称一致

rules.logic: assert COMMERCIAL_ORDER.contract_no == COMMERCIAL_CONTRACT.contract_no; assert WAYBILL.contract_no == COMMERCIAL_CONTRACT.contract_no and WAYBILL.order_no == COMMERCIAL_ORDER.order_no; assert PROFORMA_INVOICE.order_no == COMMERCIAL_ORDER.order_no; assert CUSTOMS_DECLARATION.contract_no in {COMMERCIAL_CONTRACT.contract_no, COMMERCIAL_ORDER.order_no, PROFORMA_INVOICE.invoice_no}; if CUSTOMS_DECLARATION covers multiple docs: query_customs_website()
rules.note: 订单/运单/发票的合同号需与合同一致；运单/发票的订单号与订单一致；报关单协议号与合同/订单/发票号之一相符；一单多合同可查海关网站

rules.logic: assert WAYBILL.bill_of_lading_no == CUSTOMS_DECLARATION.bill_of_lading_no; verify_authenticity(WAYBILL.bill_of_lading_no, sources=['海关网站','船公司','FIATA'])
rules.note: 提单号相符；并做真伪验证（海关网站/船公司/FIATA）

rules.logic: assert contains_chain(COMMERCIAL_CONTRACT.goods_or_service >= COMMERCIAL_ORDER.goods_or_service >= PROFORMA_INVOICE.goods_or_service == WAYBILL.goods_or_service == CUSTOMS_DECLARATION.goods_or_service) matched by same doc_no (consider cross-document partial goods); if PAYMENT_INSTRUCTION.remittance_remark mentions contract/order/goods: assert consistent; DRAWDOWN_INSTRUCTION.purpose is a superset; check forbidden_field(goods_or_service); check regulation_requirement(goods_or_service); check goods_in_FOL_purpose(FACILITY_LETTER.purpose) and loan_eligible(goods_or_service); check goods_in_borrower_business_scope; translate_and_explain(goods_or_service, payment_terms, effective_terms)
rules.note: 除提款指令外文件采购/服务标的应一致(含交叉/部分货品)；同编号下比对；支付指令附言若含编号/货名应相符；提款指令用途概括为包含关系；检查禁止领域/监管/FOL用途/经营范围；翻译关键信息

rules.logic: assert COMMERCIAL_CONTRACT.date <= min(COMMERCIAL_ORDER.date, WAYBILL.shipment_date, CUSTOMS_DECLARATION.date, PROFORMA_INVOICE.date); validate_date_logic_by_payment_terms(COMMERCIAL_CONTRACT.payment_terms); if payment_terms specify window: assert DRAWDOWN_INSTRUCTION.drawdown_date within window from shipment/invoice; else: assert (DRAWDOWN_INSTRUCTION.drawdown_date - earliest_invoice_date) <= 3 months; assert PAYMENT_INSTRUCTION.payment_date <= DRAWDOWN_INSTRUCTION.drawdown_date
rules.note: 合同日期最早；按支付条款判断各文件日期合理性(订单/运单/报关单为非必需)；提款日期合理性，无条款则最早发票到提款不超3个月；支付指令付款日不晚于提款日

rules.logic: assert all_equal([COMMERCIAL_CONTRACT.seller, COMMERCIAL_ORDER.seller, WAYBILL.seller, PROFORMA_INVOICE.seller]) == PAYMENT_INSTRUCTION.payee (CUSTOMS_DECLARATION may be transport_party); check seller_not_related_party(FACILITY_LETTER.borrower); check seller_country not in SANCTIONED_COUNTRIES
rules.note: 同套合同/订单/运单/发票销售方一致且与支付指令收款方相符(报关单可能是运输方)；检查关联方；检查制裁国

rules.logic: assert all_equal([COMMERCIAL_CONTRACT.buyer, COMMERCIAL_ORDER.buyer, WAYBILL.buyer, PROFORMA_INVOICE.buyer]) == FACILITY_LETTER.borrower (CUSTOMS_DECLARATION may be transport_party)
rules.note: 同套文件收货方/买方一致且与借款人相符(报关单可能是运输方)

rules.logic: assert PAYMENT_INSTRUCTION.payee_bank_country == WAYBILL.country_of_departure == CUSTOMS_DECLARATION.country_of_departure; assert PAYMENT_INSTRUCTION.payee_bank_country == bank_country_in([COMMERCIAL_CONTRACT, COMMERCIAL_ORDER, PROFORMA_INVOICE]); check PAYMENT_INSTRUCTION.payee_bank_country not in SANCTIONED_COUNTRIES
rules.note: 支付收款行所在国与运单/报关单启运国相同、与合同/订单/发票涉及收款行国家相同；检查制裁国

rules.logic: for each seller: assert PAYMENT_INSTRUCTION.amount <= PROFORMA_INVOICE.amount <= CUSTOMS_DECLARATION.amount / WAYBILL.amount <= COMMERCIAL_ORDER.amount <= COMMERCIAL_CONTRACT.amount; assert chain COMMERCIAL_CONTRACT.amount >= COMMERCIAL_ORDER.amount >= PROFORMA_INVOICE.amount (consider cross-document/partial goods)
rules.note: 同销售方支付指令金额 <= 发票/报关单/运单/订单/合同金额；同套 合同>=订单>=发票(含交叉/部分货品)

rules.logic: assert PROFORMA_INVOICE.quantity <= min(CUSTOMS_DECLARATION.quantity, WAYBILL.quantity, COMMERCIAL_ORDER.quantity, COMMERCIAL_CONTRACT.quantity)
rules.note: 形式发票货物数量 <= 报关单/运单/订单/合同数量

rules.logic: assert PROFORMA_INVOICE.unit_price == CUSTOMS_DECLARATION.unit_price; if COMMERCIAL_CONTRACT and COMMERCIAL_ORDER have fixed unit_price and no floating clause: assert PROFORMA_INVOICE.unit_price == COMMERCIAL_ORDER.unit_price == COMMERCIAL_CONTRACT.unit_price; elif floating clause exists: assert floating_clause_present(); handle tax_inclusive vs tax_exclusive
rules.note: 发票单价=报关单；合同/订单有明确固定单价且无浮动条款时发票单价=订单=合同；有浮动条款则显示即可；区分含税/不含税

rules.logic: if has_effective_clause(COMMERCIAL_CONTRACT): assert meets_effective_clause(); assert same_company_same_type_seal_identical([COMMERCIAL_CONTRACT, COMMERCIAL_ORDER, PROFORMA_INVOICE]); if no effective_clause: suggest_by_local_rule(); check contract_not_expired(COMMERCIAL_CONTRACT.effective_terms)
rules.note: 有生效条款则符合条款；同公司同性质章一致；无条款按当地普适规则建议；检查合同是否过期失效

rules.logic: if COMMERCIAL_CONTRACT.payee_account is not null or COMMERCIAL_ORDER.payee_account is not null: assert PAYMENT_INSTRUCTION.payee_account == (COMMERCIAL_CONTRACT.payee_account or COMMERCIAL_ORDER.payee_account)
rules.note: 若合同/订单有收款账号信息(户名/账号/银行)，检查支付指令收款信息与之一致

rules.logic: if COMMERCIAL_CONTRACT.payment_method is not null or COMMERCIAL_ORDER.payment_method is not null: assert payment_method in ['转账', 'TT', '现金']
rules.note: 若合同/订单有明确支付方式，检查是否为转账/TT/现金
